# SetPanelColor <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetPanelColor:Void panel:Int32, red:Int32, green:Int32, blue:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `panel` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a panel. |
| `red` | In | Int32 | required | Red part, 0 to 255. |
| `green` | In | Int32 | required | Green part, 0 to 255. |
| `blue` | In | Int32 | required | Blue part, 0 to 255. |

## Description

Fills a panel with a color.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Color", 10, 10, 300, 140, Desktop(), 3)
p   = CreatePanel(10, 10, 100, 80, win)
SetPanelColor p, 255, 120, 0
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
